title: Ledo Kaili language - Wikipedia
text: Ledo Kaili is the largest member of the Kaili languages, which are a dialect chain within the Kaili-Pamona language family. These languages are spoken in Central Sulawesi (Indonesia).

title: Kaili language - Wikipedia
text: Kaili is an Austronesian dialect cluster of the Celebic branch, and is one of the principal languages of Central Sulawesi. The heartland of the Kaili area is the broad Palu River valley which stretches southward from Central Sulawesi's capital city, Palu.

title: Kaili-Ledo
text: Ledo is the main dialect of the Kaili language, spoken around the city of Palu and along the Palu River in Central Sulawesi, Indonesia. text: Music This page has some examples of traditional songs, dero, and raego. Dero and raego are a combination of singing and slow dancing. They are primarily a form of entertainment and group solidarity, not part of any religious ritual.
